     I. DigiLocker allows students to securely store and access authentic digital academic certificates.
     II. Documents issued directly to DigiLocker by registered issuers are legally at par with original physical documents.
     III. DigiLocker eliminates the need for schools to maintain any internal student databases.
     IV. DigiLocker is integrated with Aadhaar for user authentication.
     Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and III
I, II and IV
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
explanation_english: DigiLocker integrates with Aadhaar authentication to provide students with secure access to authentic digital academic certificates. Documents issued directly into DigiLocker repositories by recognized educational boards possess legal validity equal to original physical documents under electronic governance rules. While simplifying certificate verification and reducing physical paperwork, DigiLocker functions as a document storage facility rather than replacing internal school databases.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। DigiLocker आधार प्रमाणीकरण के साथ एकीकृत है जिससे छात्रों को प्रामाणिक डिजिटल शैक्षणिक प्रमाणपत्रों तक सुरक्षित पहुंच मिलती है। DigiLocker में पंजीकृत शैक्षणिक बोर्डों द्वारा सीधे जारी किए गए दस्तावेज़ भौतिक दस्तावेज़ों के समान कानूनी मान्यता रखते हैं। यह प्रमाणपत्र सत्यापन को सरल बनाते हुए और भौतिक कागजी कार्रवाई को कम करते हुए, DigiLocker एक दस्तावेज़ भंडारण सुविधा के रूप में कार्य करता है, न कि आंतरिक स्कूल डेटाबेस को प्रतिस्थापित करने के रूप में।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II and IV
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: DigiLocker integrates with Aadhaar authentication to provide students with secure access to authentic digital academic certificates.

question_english: The Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) is a critical metric when evaluating the adoption of ICT in schools. Which of the following is NOT typically included in the TCO of a new smart classroom system?
options_english: The salaries of the students’ parents
Initial hardware procurement cost
Ongoing software licensing and maintenance fees
Costs associated with training teachers to use the system
explanation_english: Total Cost of Ownership evaluations assess all direct and indirect expenses associated with acquiring, operating, and maintaining technology infrastructure over its complete operational lifecycle. Key financial components include initial hardware procurement, software licensing, system upgrades, technical support, and continuous staff training. Personal domestic finances, such as parental salaries, fall entirely outside organizational infrastructure cost calculations and institutional asset management.

question_english: Which of the following practices represents a significant cybersecurity vulnerability in school digital record management?
options_english: Enforcing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) protocols across all administrative MIS modules
Mandatory implementation of Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for accessing school financial databases
Sharing administrative login credentials among multiple temporary staff
Systematically conducting regular, offsite external data backups for disaster recovery
explanation_english: Sharing administrative credentials among multiple temporary personnel severely compromises cybersecurity by destroying individual accountability and audit trail integrity. Unrestricted credential sharing exposes sensitive student records to unauthorized access, accidental modification, or malicious data breaches. Standard cybersecurity policies mandate unique user accounts, strict role-based access permissions, and individual authentication to maintain system security and data confidentiality.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कई अस्थायी कर्मचारियों के बीच प्रशासनिक क्रेडेंशियल साझा करना साइबर सुरक्षा को गंभीर रूप से कमजोर करता है। यह व्यक्तिगत जिम्मेदारी और ऑडिट ट्रेल की अखंडता को नष्ट करता है। बिना किसी प्रतिबंध के क्रेडेंशियल साझा करने से संवेदनशील छात्र रिकॉर्ड अनधिकृत पहुंच, आकस्मिक संशोधन या दुर्भावनापूर्ण डेटा उल्लंघनों के लिए उजागर हो जाते हैं। मानक साइबर सुरक्षा नीतियों में अद्वितीय उपयोगकर्ता खातों, सख्त भूमिका-आधारित पहुंच अनुमतियों और व्यक्तिगत प्रमाणीकरण की आवश्यकता होती है ताकि प्रणाली की सुरक्षा और डेटा की गोपनीयता बनाए रखी जा सके।

question_english: What is the primary purpose of registering under the Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) platform as mandated by TRAI for schools sending bulk SMS?

To construct a decentralized blockchain network for verifying secondary school completion certificates

question_english:
Which of the following options represents an application of Decision Support Systems (DSS) in educational management?

I. Analyzing database trends to inform dropout interventions and resource allocation.
II. Utilizing desktop word processing applications to manually format and print weekly class timetables.
III. Transmitting mass electronic mail announcements to parents regarding unexpected administrative school closures.
IV. Maintaining traditional physical paper ledgers for recording laboratory inventory and equipment usage.
options_english: Analyzing database trends to inform dropout interventions and resource allocation.
Utilizing desktop word processing applications to manually format and print weekly class timetables.
Transmitting mass electronic mail announcements to parents regarding unexpected administrative school closures.
Maintaining traditional physical paper ledgers for recording laboratory inventory and equipment usage.
explanation_english: The correct option is 'Analyzing database trends to inform dropout interventions and resource allocation.' Decision Support Systems utilize analytical database software to process complex operational data, identifying underlying performance trends, attendance patterns, and resource gaps. School administrators leverage these predictive insights to design targeted student dropout interventions, optimize teaching staff deployment, and allocate financial assets strategically. Transforming raw administrative data into actionable intelligence enhances policy planning and operational effectiveness across educational systems.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। निर्णय समर्थन प्रणाली (DSS) जटिल संचालन डेटा को संसाधित करने के लिए विश्लेषणात्मक डेटाबेस सॉफ़्टवेयर का उपयोग करती हैं, जो अंतर्निहित प्रदर्शन प्रवृत्तियों, उपस्थिति पैटर्न और संसाधन अंतराल की पहचान करती हैं। स्कूल प्रशासक इन पूर्वानुमानात्मक अंतर्दृष्टियों का उपयोग लक्षित छात्र ड्रॉपआउट हस्तक्षेपों को डिजाइन करने, शिक्षण स्टाफ की तैनाती को अनुकूलित करने और वित्तीय संपत्तियों को रणनीतिक रूप से आवंटित करने के लिए करते हैं। कच्चे प्रशासनिक डेटा को क्रियाशील बुद्धिमत्ता में बदलना नीति योजना और शैक्षिक प्रणालियों में संचालन की प्रभावशीलता को बढ़ाता है।

question_english:
Identify the correct pair of cybersecurity concept and its definition:

I. Malware - Specialized optimization software designed to improve overall operating system performance.
II. Phishing - High-level cryptographic technique for securing confidential data into an unreadable format.
III. Decryption - Unauthorized technical procedure for exploiting software bugs to access protected servers.
IV. Firewall - Security device monitoring and filtering network traffic.
options_english: Malware - Specialized optimization software designed to improve overall operating system performance.
Phishing - High-level cryptographic technique for securing confidential data into an unreadable format.
Decryption - Unauthorized technical procedure for exploiting software bugs to access protected servers.
Firewall - Security device monitoring and filtering network traffic.
explanation_english: The correct option is 'Firewall - Security device monitoring and filtering network traffic.' A firewall is an essential network security barrier that monitors, inspects, and filters incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predefined security rules. It prevents unauthorized external access, blocks malicious software traffic, and secures internal school servers from external cyber threats. Operating as hardware or software, firewalls maintain network integrity and establish secure boundaries for educational management information systems.

Interoperability - The ability of different IT systems to exchange and utilize data seamlessly
Bandwidth - Statutory legal frameworks enforcing intellectual property rights and digital copyright protections
Open Source - Commercial software architecture whose underlying source code is kept strictly secret and licensed
explanation_english: Interoperability refers to the capability of diverse information technology platforms and administrative software applications to communicate, exchange data, and interpret shared information seamlessly without custom interface modifications. In public educational management, interoperable systems facilitate automatic data synchronization between local school management systems, state educational portals, and national databases, ensuring data consistency and operational efficiency.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Interoperability - The ability of different IT systems to exchange and utilize data seamlessly

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Interoperability refers to the capability of diverse information technology platforms and administrative software applications to communicate, exchange data, and interpret shared information seamlessly without custom interface modifications.

question_english: A school administration office relies entirely on a single local computer for maintaining all financial records without any backup. What is the most immediate risk associated with this practice?
options_english: Severe network latency and bandwidth throttling across administrative office connections
Statutory non-compliance and violation of the provisions under the Right to Education Act
Technical software interoperability and data compatibility issues across departmental operating systems
Single point of failure causing total loss during hardware malfunction.
explanation_english: Relying entirely on a standalone computer for financial data storage without offsite or secondary backups creates a dangerous single point of failure. Any sudden hardware breakdown, storage drive failure, malware infection, or physical catastrophe can permanently destroy critical accounting records. Best practices require systematic data replication, automated cloud synchronization, and offsite physical backups to ensure operational continuity.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। एकल कंप्यूटर पर पूरी तरह से निर्भर रहना जो बैकअप के बिना वित्तीय डेटा को संग्रहीत करता है, एक खतरनाक एकल बिंदु विफलता उत्पन्न करता है। कोई भी अचानक हार्डवेयर टूटना, भंडारण ड्राइव विफलता, मैलवेयर संक्रमण, या भौतिक आपदा महत्वपूर्ण लेखांकन रिकॉर्ड को स्थायी रूप से नष्ट कर सकती है। सर्वोत्तम प्रथाओं में प्रणालीगत डेटा पुनरुत्पादन, स्वचालित क्लाउड समन्वय, और संचालन निरंतरता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए ऑफसाइट भौतिक बैकअप की आवश्यकता होती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Single point of failure causing total loss

Prevention of tampering and physical deterioration
Increased difficulty in tracking leave balances
Seamless transfer of records upon employee relocation
explanation_english: Digitizing personnel service books streamlines human resource management by providing instant retrieval of employment records, protecting paper files from physical degradation, and simplifying inter-departmental staff transfers. Contrary to creating operational friction, electronic service books automate leave accumulation calculations and maintain transparent service tracking, eliminating manual processing errors and administrative delays associated with traditional paper ledgers.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सेवा पुस्तकों को डिजिटाइज़ करने से कर्मचारियों के रिकॉर्ड की त्वरित पुनर्प्राप्ति, भौतिक क्षति से सुरक्षा और रिकॉर्ड के निर्बाध हस्तांतरण में सहायता मिलती है। जबकि छुट्टी के संतुलन को ट्रैक करने में कठिनाई बढ़ाना एक नकारात्मक पहलू है, डिजिटाइज़ेशन वास्तव में प्रबंधन प्रक्रियाओं को सरल बनाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Increased difficulty in tracking leave balances

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Digitizing personnel service books streamlines human resource management by providing instant retrieval of employment records, protecting paper files from physical degradation, and simplifying inter-departmental staff transfers.

question_english: What is the most appropriate action for a Principal if they observe that a newly introduced parent-communication app has extremely low adoption rates among the EWS category parents?

explanation_english: When facing low adoption rates for parent communication software among disadvantaged demographics, administrators should investigate technical barriers, digital access limitations, and literacy constraints. question_english: What is the primary function of a 'Captive Portal' in a school's Wi-Fi network?
options_english: To automatically capture facial photographs of students and staff entering the computer laboratory facility
To permanently isolate and trap incoming network malware threats within an isolated software sandbox
To require user authentication or agreement to policies before accessing the internet.
To serve as a high-capacity offline network storage device for archiving pre-recorded classroom video lectures
explanation_english: The correct answer is that a captive portal requires user authentication or agreement to policies before accessing the internet. A captive portal is a specialized network web page that intercepts wireless network traffic, requiring users to authenticate credentials or accept terms of service before accessing the broader internet. In school Wi-Fi environments, captive portals manage guest connections, track network usage, restrict unauthorized access, and ensure compliance with institutional acceptable use internet policies.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कैप्टिव पोर्टल का कार्य उपयोगकर्ता प्रमाणीकरण या नीतियों से सहमति की आवश्यकता करना है। यह एक विशेष नेटवर्क वेब पृष्ठ है जो वायरलेस नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक को अवरुद्ध करता है, उपयोगकर्ताओं को व्यापक इंटरनेट तक पहुँचने से पहले प्रमाणीकरण क्रेडेंशियल्स या सेवा की शर्तों को स्वीकार करने की आवश्यकता होती है। स्कूल के वाई-फाई वातावरण में, कैप्टिव पोर्टल मेहमान कनेक्शनों का प्रबंधन करता है, नेटवर्क उपयोग को ट्रैक करता है, अनधिकृत पहुँच को प्रतिबंधित करता है, और संस्थागत स्वीकार्य उपयोग इंटरनेट नीतियों के अनुपालन को सुनिश्चित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) To require user authentication or agreement

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A captive portal is a specialized network web page that intercepts wireless network traffic, requiring users to authenticate credentials or accept terms of service before accessing the broader internet.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): Synchronous online communication tools are always superior to asynchronous tools for all school administrative tasks. 
Reason (R): Synchronous tools require all participants to be present at the same time, which is highly practical for staff members with varying teaching schedules.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: The correct answer is that A is false but R is true. Synchronous online tools require simultaneous real-time participation, making them less suitable for routine administrative communication among teaching staff with varying, conflicting classroom schedules. Asynchronous communication methods, such as email and shared digital drives, allow staff to review messages flexibly. While synchronous tools excel for interactive live discussions, claiming they are universally superior ignores operational requirements.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। असर्शन (A) असत्य है लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है। समकालिक ऑनलाइन उपकरणों को वास्तविक समय में समानांतर भागीदारी की आवश्यकता होती है, जिससे वे विभिन्न, संघर्षशील कक्षा कार्यक्रमों वाले शिक्षण स्टाफ के बीच नियमित प्रशासनिक संचार के लिए कम उपयुक्त हो जाते हैं। असमकालिक संचार विधियाँ, जैसे ईमेल और साझा डिजिटल ड्राइव, स्टाफ को लचीले ढंग से संदेशों की समीक्षा करने की अनुमति देती हैं। जबकि समकालिक उपकरण इंटरैक्टिव लाइव चर्चाओं के लिए उत्कृष्ट होते हैं, यह दावा करना कि वे सार्वभौमिक रूप से श्रेष्ठ हैं, संचालनात्मक आवश्यकताओं की अनदेखी करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Synchronous online tools require simultaneous real-time participation, making them less suitable for routine administrative communication among teaching staff with varying, conflicting classroom schedules.

question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the e-governance policy of data classification.
options_english: Routine circulars regarding school timings are classified as public information.
Draft examination question papers are classified as open-access data prior to the exam.
Individual student psychological assessments are classified as sensitive personal data.
Teacher biometric attendance logs are restricted for administrative use.
explanation_english: The incorrect statement is that draft examination question papers are classified as open-access data prior to the exam. In reality, under institutional data classification policies, draft examination question papers are strictly classified as confidential and sensitive information that requires secure handling before test administration.
